provenance.note: benchmark 任务草稿：语料变换生成（E6：错误注入来自真实语料，非规则反推）；gold/difficulty 由标注管线填充

decisions.rationale: GSE132465 CRC 10X raw UMI matrix validated: 63,689 cells × 25,655 genes, no duplicate barcodes, tumor/normal labels intact across 10 patients (SMC01-SMC10).
Fixed thresholds: mito<25%, genes 200-6000. Simple and widely used.
Doublet rate is low (<5%), skipping to save compute time.

SCTransform regularized negative-binomial regression — best variance stabilization for scRNA UMI counts. CRC TME has diverse cell types (epithelial, immune, stromal) with different library sizes, making variance stabilization critical (Hafemeister & Satija 2019, PMID 31870423).
Seurat v3 VST selected 3,000 HVGs — standard for scRNA clustering. Sufficient to capture immune and tumor expression programs in CRC TME.

Harmony iterative soft-clustering for 10-patient batch integration. CRC samples from multiple patients require batch correction to avoid patient-specific clustering (Korsunsky et al. 2019, PMID 31740819).

Leiden algorithm with resolution 1.2, resolution scanned across range, selected by stability analysis — CRC TME requires slightly higher resolution to separate CD4+/CD8+ T cell subsets and monocyte/macrophage populations (Traag et al. 2019, PMID 30914743).

CellTypist (immune-focused model) + SingleR (Blueprint/ENCODE reference) cross-validation. CRC TME is immune-infiltrated — dual immune annotation methods provide robust cell type identification. Marker dotplot verification for all major lineages (Aran et al. 2019 PMID 31209304; Dominguez Conde et al. 2022 PMID 35649401).

Pseudobulk aggregation at patient level + DESeq2 Wald test — patients are biological replicates. CRC tumor vs normal DEG requires proper pseudoreplication handling (Squair et al. 2021, PMID 34433851).

CellTypist and SingleR annotations concordant on 92% of cells. 38 clusters map to 8 major cell types. Marker dotplot confirms T cell (CD3D/CD8A/CD4), B cell (CD19/MS4A1), myeloid (CD14/CD68), and epithelial (EPCAM) lineages with clear separation.
